title: Turn_Zille_WarSmolakFinalParley
description: Pojedynek ze Smolakiem w Namiocie Polowym
modNote: Pojedynek ze Smolakiem w Namiocie Polowym

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Smolak_Parley_Intro
entries.dialogueText: The neutral pavilion stood on a muddy rise between the forward trenches, draped in white flags snapping in the salt breeze off the Gulf of Moridia. Outside, Golden Guards in gold-trimmed greatcoats stood eye-to-eye with Wehzek guardsmen holding submachine guns. Inside, Wiktor Smolak sat slumped in a folding chair, pouring bitter black tea into a tin cup, a half-smoked cigarette dangling from his lips.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Parley_Greeting
entries.dialogueText: Look who finally arrived! The great King Romus of Rizia in the flesh. Tell me, Your Majesty... Do you care for tea? Wehzek chicory blend. Tastes like gunpowder and mud, yet it keeps a man awake while the artillery roars.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Romus_Parley_Posture_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: I sat across the scarred folding table, looking into the bloodshot, calculating eyes of the Wehzek president.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Posture_Victor
entries.dialogueText: Your garrisons are broken and your sea lanes across the Gulf are severed, Smolak. We are not here to drink tea. Sign the evacuation instrument and pull your surviving troops back across the sea to Wehlen today.
entries.menuText: "Your army is shattered, Smolak. Sign the capitulation and evacuate Zille today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Posture_Stalemate
entries.dialogueText: Both our nations have bled enough into this mud, Smolak. If this slaughter continues, neither of us will have an economy left. Let us discuss terms for an end to hostilities.
entries.menuText: "Both our armies have bled enough. Let us discuss a realistic settlement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Posture_Defiant
entries.dialogueText: You brought this ruin upon Wehlen when you thought you could extort House Toras and hold Rizian soil hostage. Every drop of blood spilled rests on your head.
entries.menuText: "You brought this defeat upon yourself when you tried to extort House Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Posture_Defeated
entries.dialogueText: Fortune turned against our arms on the field, Wiktor. Spare me your theatrics and put your terms on the table so we may stop the slaughter.
entries.menuText: "Our offensive has stalled, Wiktor. Let us speak plainly about halting the bloodshed."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Defeated_Rant
entries.dialogueText: Smolak ground his cigarette into the floorboards beneath his boot, his hands trembling with suppressed fury. "You think you're a conqueror, Romus? You think waving a map makes you a hero?! Fine! Valdez blundered, and my generals couldn't organize a parade in Wraclawitz!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Defeated_Terms
entries.dialogueText: "Take Zille! Take your precious mines and harbors! Yet Wehlen will not pay a single coin of tribute! Let my surviving boys embark by sea back to mainland Wehlen with their rifles, and I will sign your damned treaty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Victory_Terms_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: Smolak leaned across the table, cornered, desperate, yet stubbornly bargaining for survival.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Accept_Decisive_Surrender
entries.dialogueText: Zille returns unconditionally to the Crown of Rizia, effective immediately. Your surviving garrisons may evacuate across the Gulf of Moridia under white flags. Yet if a single Wehzek soldier sets foot in Zille again, it means total war.
entries.menuText: "Zille returns unconditionally to Rizia. Your surviving troops may evacuate by sea."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Signs_Decisive
entries.dialogueText: Smolak snatched the pen, scribbling his signature with vicious, jagged strokes before tossing it onto the parchment. "Done! Pack up, boys, we're sailing home! Enjoy your oilfields and your headaches, Romus!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Demand_Overwhelming_Triumph
entries.dialogueText: Not enough, Smolak. Our forces already hold deep targets in mainland Wehlen. You will cede Zille, pay massive gold and energy reparations, demilitarize your coast, and accept protected Free City status for Grodzizg. Sign, or our columns push straight toward Wraclawitz!
entries.menuText: "Not enough. You will cede Zille, pay massive war indemnities, and grant Grodzizg autonomy!"
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] = 5; Variable["Zille_Independent_Buffer"] = false; Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] = true; Variable["Grodzizg_FreeCity"] = true; Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] or 0) + 4; Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Energy"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Energy"] or 0) + 3;

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Signs_Overwhelming
entries.dialogueText: Smolak turned ashen, his bravado evaporating into panic as he stared at the map pins deep inside Wehlen. "You're ruthless, Romus... an absolute shark! Damn you... I'll sign. Just halt your armor! Keep Rotsla and Wraclawitz out of this!" He signed with shaking hands.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Stalemate_Opening
entries.dialogueText: Smolak took a deep drag of his cigarette, blowing gray smoke toward the canvas roof. "Neither of us can break the other, Romus. Your tanks stalled on the approaches to Zille City, and my boys can't crack Brenas. We can keep feeding young men into artillery fire until Kyrute chains us both... or we can be clever."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Buffer_Proposal
entries.dialogueText: "Here is my offer: an Independent Zille. Neither Rizia nor Wehlen. A demilitarized neutral buffer state, governed by a joint civilian council, with guaranteed oil and sea transit rights for both our nations. Neither of us loses face. What do you say, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Stalemate_Hub_Lucita
entries.dialogueText: Lucita frowned with deep skepticism, while Smolak watched your eyes like a card shark staking his final hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Stalemate_Hub_NoLucita
entries.dialogueText: Your staff officers exchanged tense glances while Smolak watched your eyes like a card shark staking his final hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Accept_Independent_Buffer
entries.dialogueText: An Independent Neutral Zille. It ends the bloodshed, rescues our economy, and frees the people of Zille from your grip while separating our borders. I accept. Let the Alliance of Nations ratify the neutral charter.
entries.menuText: "Agreed. Zille shall become an Independent Neutral Buffer State under international guarantee."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Buffer_Signed
entries.dialogueText: Smolak smiled, a genuine glint of shrewd relief in his eyes as he tapped his tin cup against the table. "A statesman's compromise, Romus. Let the clerks in Konstantium draft the charters. The war is over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Reject_Buffer_Ceasefire
entries.dialogueText: Zille has been Rizian for centuries; I will never recognize an artificial state carved out of our historical province. We freeze the lines under an armed ceasefire—and remember that this dispute is not over.
entries.menuText: "Never. Zille is Rizian or nothing. We freeze the frontlines under an armed ceasefire."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Ceasefire_Signed
entries.dialogueText: Smolak snorted, flicking his cigarette butt into the mud. "Suit yourself, King. An armed truce it is. Just keep your border sentries' fingers off their triggers."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Victorious_Mock
entries.dialogueText: Smolak leaned back with a theatrical, predatory grin, spreading his arms wide. "Ah! How quickly royal arrogance melts when the shells stop flying, eh, Romus? You marched north expecting a coronation parade, and instead General Valdez broke your spearheads!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_TacticalDefeat_Terms
entries.dialogueText: "Your adventure cost thousands of lives and gained you nothing. Withdraw your battered divisions behind the Brenas line, drop your claim to Zille, and pay Wehlen modest customs compensation—and I will refrain from marching further south."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Fiasco_Terms
entries.dialogueText: "My armored columns are sitting inside Brenas right now, 'Your Majesty'! You gambled and lost everything. Sign the surrender of southern Brenas and pay war indemnities to Wraclawitz, or I let my troops march all the way to Porte Drazon!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Accept_Tactical_Defeat
entries.dialogueText: To spare our kingdom further ruin, Rizia accepts an armistice along the pre-war frontier and suspends military claims over Zille. Do not mistake restraint for surrender, Wiktor.
entries.menuText: "We will withdraw behind the Brenas frontier and sign the armistice."
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] = 2; Variable["Zille_Independent_Buffer"] = false; Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] = false; Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Lost"] = true;

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Signs_TacticalDefeat
entries.dialogueText: Smolak cackled softly, signing with an exaggerated flourish. "Oh, I wouldn't dream of underestimating you, Romus. Enjoy explaining this triumph to your noble houses!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Accept_Total_Fiasco
entries.dialogueText: To save the capital and our citizens from total devastation, I accept your terms. Withdraw from the approaches to Porte Drazon.
entries.menuText: "Sign the humiliating surrender of southern Brenas to save Porte Drazon."
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] = 1; Variable["Zille_Independent_Buffer"] = false; Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] = false; Variable["Brenas_Lost_To_Wehlen"] = true;

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Smolak_Signs_Fiasco
entries.dialogueText: Smolak laughed uproariously, slapping the table. "History will remember today, King Romus! Your father gave me Zille; you just handed me Brenas! Good luck surviving your own generals tonight!"
